text: 目前没有名为 "text-to-cad" 的独立 skill。 不过，我有一个 **`cad`** skill，功能非常接近——它支持通过自然语言描述来创建、修改和验证 STEP 格式的 CAD 零件和装配体（基于 build123d/Python）。如果你需要"用文字描述生成 CAD 模型"，这个 skill 可以满足需求。 需要我读取 `cad` skill 的 SKILL.md 来帮你使用吗？

**是同一个 skill，但版本有差异。** 两个 SKILL.md 都来自 `earthtojake/text-to-cad` 仓库，核心内容一致： | 对比项 | 本地工作区版本 | GitHub 最新版 | |--------|--------------|--------------| | **名称** | `cad` | `cad` | | **描述** | 相同 | 相同 | | **核心工作流** | 10 步流程 | 10 步流程 | | **Launcher 工具** | `step`, `inspect`, `render`, `dxf` | `step`, `inspect`, `dxf` (无 render) | | **查看器** | `$cad-explorer` | `$render` | | **渲染策略** | "条件渲染" | "分级视觉审查" + 快照 | | **参考文件** | 8 个 | 10 个（多了 `parameters.md` 和 `render-review.md`） | **主要差异：** - GitHub 版更新了术语（`$cad-explorer` → `$render`），渲染流程更细化 - GitHub 版新增了参数/动画设计（`parameters.md`）和渲染审查（`render-review.md`）两个参考文件 如果你需要用最新版，我可以把你本地的 SKILL.md 更新为 GitHub 上的版本。需要更新吗？

已更新完成。`cad` skill 的 SKILL.md 已同步至 GitHub 最新版，主要变更： - **术语更新**：`$cad-explorer` → `$render` - **新增参考文件**：`parameters.md`（参数/动画设计）、`render-review.md`（渲染审查流程） - **渲染策略升级**：从简单的"条件渲染"改为"分级视觉审查"，支持快照诊断和语义验证

Create a 3D model of a female pin header connector (PCB socket) with the following specifications: Body (plastic housing): - Material: black thermoplastic, rectangular block - Dimensions: 12.7mm length × 5.0mm width × 8.5mm height - The 8.5mm height is measured from the top face to the PCB mating face Contact arrangement: - Dual row (2 rows), 10 positions total (5 positions per row) - Pin pitch: 2.54mm in both X and Y directions - Each position has a square socket opening on the top face for male pin insertion - Sockets are recessed into the plastic body Through-hole pins: - 10 metal pins (matching the 10 socket positions) extending downward from the bottom face - Each pin: square cross-section, approximately 0.5mm × 0.5mm - Pin length: 3.3mm protruding below the bottom face (for PCB insertion and soldering) - Pins arranged in dual-row 2.54mm grid pattern Critical features: - The top face has 10 small rectangular openings aligned with the contact positions - The plastic body has slight chamfers or beveled edges (about 0.3mm) on the top perimeter - Body is one solid piece of insulating plastic Output format: STEP file, units in millimeters.

**排母连接器 3D 模型生成完成！** ```datatable { "title": "验证结果", "columns": [ { "key": "item", "label": "检查项", "type": "text" }, { "key": "expected", "label": "预期值", "type": "text" }, { "key": "actual", "label": "实际值", "type": "text" }, { "key": "status", "label": "状态", "type": "badge" } ], "rows": [ { "item": "BBox X", "expected": "12.7 mm", "actual": "12.7 mm", "status": "PASS" }, { "item": "BBox Y", "expected": "5.0 mm", "actual": "5.0 mm", "status": "PASS" }, { "item": "BBox Z", "expected": "~11.8 mm (8.5+3.3)", "actual": "11.8 mm", "status": "PASS" }, { "item": "子件数量", "expected": "11 (1本体+10引脚)", "actual": "11", "status": "PASS" }, { "item": "面数", "expected": ">116 (含倒角)", "actual": "120", "status": "PASS" }, { "item": "顶面倒角", "expected": "0.3mm", "actual": "已确认 (顶面bbox缩小)", "status": "PASS" }, { "item": "引脚突出", "expected": "3.3 mm (Z=-3.3)", "actual": "底部Z = -3.3", "status": "PASS" } ] } ``` **生成的文件：** | 文件 | 路径 | |------|------| | STEP 模型 | `{{SESSION_PATH}}/female_pin_header.step` | | Python 源码 | `{{SESSION_PATH}}/female_pin_header.py` | **模型结构：** - `female_pin_header_2x5` (Compound) - `plastic_housing` — 12.7×5.0×8.5mm 塑料本体，顶边 0.3mm 倒角 - `pins` — 10 根 0.5×0.5mm 方形引脚，双排 2.54mm 间距，底部伸出 3.3mm - `pin_r0_c0` ~ `pin_r1_c4` — 各引脚独立标签 **注：** 插孔开口尺寸（1.0mm 方形、深度 5.0mm）为合理假设值，若实际规格不同请告知。`$render` 查看器未配置，如需可视化可渲染快照。
在cad中打开啊，不然我怎么检验

排母连接器 3D 交互式查看器已生成： ```html-preview {"src": "{{SESSION_PATH}}/data/viewer.html", "title": "排母连接器 2x5 - 3D查看器"} ``` **操作提示：** 鼠标拖拽旋转 | 滚轮缩放 | 右键平移 模型文件路径： - STEP: `{{SESSION_PATH}}/female_pin_header.step` - STL: `{{SESSION_PATH}}/data/female_pin_header.stl`
已在 ZWCAD 2020 中打开 STEP 文件。如果 ZWCAD 没有自动显示模型，可以通过菜单 **插入 → 输入 → STEP** 手动导入。 文件路径：`{{SESSION_PATH}}\female_pin_header.step`

Create a 2D technical drawing — top view (plan view) of a dual-row female pin header with the following specifications: View orientation: Looking down from above onto the top face of the connector body. Outline: - Rectangular body: 12.7mm length × 5.0mm width - 0.3mm chamfer on all four corners of the outer perimeter Pin grid: - 10 square socket openings, arranged in 2 rows of 5 - Row spacing (center-to-center between rows): 2.54mm - Column spacing (center-to-center within each row): 2.54mm - Each socket opening: square shape, approximately 0.7mm × 0.7mm - The grid is centered on the body Annotations: - Dimension lines showing: overall 12.7mm length, 5.0mm width - Dimension showing: 2.54mm pitch between pins and between rows - Part label: "Top View" Style: Black lines on white background, standard mechanical drawing style, millimeter units. Output format: DXF or SVG file.

已在 ZWCAD 中打开 DXF 图纸。 **生成的文件：** | 文件 | 路径 | |------|------| | DXF 图纸 | `{{SESSION_PATH}}/female_pin_header.dxf` | **图纸内容：** - **顶视图** — 排母连接器俯视布局 - **外形轮廓** — 12.7×5.0mm 八边形（四角 0.3mm 倒角） - **插孔网格** — 10 个 0.7×0.7mm 方形，双排 2×5，间距 2.54mm - **中心十字线** — CENTER 图层 - **尺寸标注** — 总长 12.7mm、总宽 5.0mm、引脚间距 2.54mm、排间距 2.54mm - **标签** — "TOP VIEW" / "Female Pin Header 2x5 (2.54mm Pitch)"
ZWCAD 进程已经在运行。文件 `female_pin_header.dxf` 已在 ZWCAD 2020 中打开，你应该可以在窗口左侧标签页中找到它。 如果没看到，可以试试在 ZWCAD 里手动打开：`{{SESSION_PATH}}\female_pin_header.dxf`
